title: Quick Savory Korean Chicken Drumsticks Dosirak
description: A sweet and light solo dinner dish from the Chungcheong region of Korea, featuring chicken drumsticks cooked to perfection using the sous-vide method, making it a great plant-based friendly option when using a plant-based chicken alternative.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine Gochujang sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
Place the chicken drumsticks in a sous-vide bag and pour the sauce mixture over them.
Seal the bag and cook for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the chicken from the bag and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the chicken and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and scallions.
Serve the chicken drumsticks in a dosirak container with your choice of sides, such as kimchi or pickled vegetables.
Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
